text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto was in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
We talked for a bit. Apparently, Opera
O invited
her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
She said Opera O called herself the
"star" of the
race.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A star, huh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
But with the best of our generation here
to vie for
a shield plaque...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I guess it isn't really an overstatement.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I almost feel relieved.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Just don't expect me to put on some
show.
choice_data_list: こっちも負けてられないな
こっちも負けてられないね
choice_data_list_en: Can't let them outdo us either.
We can't let them outdo us either.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: All right... I'm off.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Raise your glasses. Pour out your
blessings. Let
your joy and amazement
overflow.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Sing, you birds! Shine, you sun! And you,
earth,
let your flora sprout from the
ground!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A new chapter begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Are we really supposed to be
cheering for
that?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Don't ask me! I don't know either, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It's like I... It's like I... argh—I haven't the
slightest
clue!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Opera O...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I won't indulge you. I don't want any
part of your
opera mess.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: All I'm here to do is race.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm going to race and win. That's all.
